_comment_top: spaarke-ai-architecture-redesign-r1 task 036 (FR-P2-07) — seed row for the AnalysisExecutionHandler 'rerun' method: the typed-handler migration of the last live legacy chat-tool capability (analysis re-execution).
_comment_routing: Runtime invocation routes to AnalysisExecutionHandler via sprk_handlerclass; sprk_configuration.method = 'rerun' selects the re-execution pipeline. Session playbook/document ids reach the handler through ChatInvocationContext.PlaybookId/DocumentId (set by AgentToolCatalogProjector); progress + document_replace SSE events emit through ChatInvocationContext.SseWriter (ADR-033 side-channel principle).
_comment_side_effect: sprk_sideeffectclass = 100000001 (Write) — a re-run persists a new sprk_analysisoutput via the engine, so the ONE confirmation gate (FR-P2-02 / ADR-039) suspends it by DECLARATION, never by tool-name list.
_comment_identity: Audit F-1 (notes/user-obo-audit.md; G-P0 ruling 2026-07-05 accept-until-cutover): the engine leg (IAnalysisOrchestrationService.ExecutePlaybookAsync) persists under application identity. sprk_permissionscope = 'app-only-engine' declares that reach explicitly; P3 task 044 deletes/OBO-migrates the remaining app-only engine legs.
_comment_capability_gate: sprk_requiredcapability = 'reanalyze' preserves the pre-migration capability gate (task-079 lineage): only playbooks declaring 'reanalyze' expose re-execution; standalone chat (CoreCapabilities) never sees it.
_comment_consumption: Read by scripts/Seed-TypedHandlers.ps1. Idempotent — UPSERT by sprk_toolcode with sprk_name 'SYS-%' safety filter.
sprk_description: Re-run the session's analysis playbook from scratch against the active document, optionally with additional instructions or focus areas. Use when the user asks to re-run, redo, or re-execute the analysis (e.g. 'rerun the analysis with more focus on financial risks'). Streams per-stage progress and replaces the document pane content with the new analysis on completion; the previous version is preserved in the client undo stack. Requires a session bound to a playbook and an active document.
_comment_availableincontexts: 100000001 = Chat only — the playbook engine must never re-enter itself via a playbook-orchestrated tool node.

sprk_jsonschema.title: analysis.rerun Request
sprk_jsonschema.description: Argument shape for chat-driven analysis re-execution. The playbook and document are taken from the session context — the LLM supplies only optional additional instructions.

additionalInstructions.description: Optional additional instructions or focus areas appended to the playbook's default instructions for the re-run.

text.description: Confirmation summary for the agent's conversation context.

analysisId.description: The new sprk_analysisoutput record id produced by the re-run.

sprk_configuration._comment: method = 'rerun' is the dispatch discriminator. Sibling row ANALYSIS-REFINE exposes the refine method.
